post.title: Cold Turkey Pro costs extra. Focus Blocker is free.
post.caption: Five fresh grudges: a site blocker without the Cold Turkey upgrade, a voice changer without Voicemod PRO, AWS maps without a Cloudcraft subscription, and two more built instead of paying.

segments.gripe: Blocking YouTube? Cold Turkey Pro costs extra.
segments.quote: I kept using Cold Turkey, then wanted something free that I could tweak myself, so I built my own.

cues.cap: Blocking YouTube? Cold Turkey Pro costs extra.

segments.gripe: Voicemod rations voices unless you go PRO.
segments.quote: Everyday voice effects should be available without a paid plan.

cues.cap: Voicemod rations voices unless you go PRO.
cues.say: Voice mod rations voices unless you go pro.
[sarcastic] Everyday voice effects should be available
